# Question Nodes

Ask the decision model a yes/no, choice or score question and branch on the answer's probability, with an uncertain route when no answer comes.

## Ask Decision Model

`decisions/AskDecisionModel`

Ask the decision model one question about a subject and read the answer as
probabilities. Nothing is sent while the decision model is off; the node
then outputs available=False and the reason in failure_code.

Question types:

- noul: yes/no; the answer is p_true
- choice: pick one of `options` (dict of option id to description); the answer is selected
- score: rate on `rubric` (list of level descriptions, lowest first); the answer is value

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state; the node sends the request only when a value reaches it |
| `subject` | `str,dict,list` | text or data the question is about (optional) |
| `instructions` | `str` | (optional) the question |
| `true_criteria` | `str` | (optional) when the answer is yes (noul, optional) |
| `false_criteria` | `str` | (optional) when the answer is no (noul, optional) |
| `options` | `dict` | (optional) choice options (choice) |
| `rubric` | `list` | (optional) score levels (score) |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `available` | `bool` | True when the decision model answered |
| `failure_code` | `str` | why there is no answer (disabled, unavailable, timeout, oversize, invalid_request ...), or None |
| `request_id` | `str` | the Decision Log request id |
| `p_true` | `float` | probability of yes (noul) |
| `selected` | `str` | the most probable option (choice) |
| `value` | `float` | the expected score (score) |
| `probabilities` | `dict,list` | probability per option (choice) or per rubric level (score) |
| `confidence` | `float` | the model's confidence (choice, score) |
| `answer` | `dict` | the full answer as a dict |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question_type` | `str` | `"noul"` | What kind of answer the question has. Choices: `noul`, `choice`, `score`. |
| `label` | `str` | `"Node graph question"` | Name of the request in the Decision Log |
| `instructions` | `text` | `""` | The question |
| `true_criteria` | `text` | `""` | When the answer is yes (noul) |
| `false_criteria` | `text` | `""` | When the answer is no (noul) |
| `options` | `dict` | `{}` | Option id to description (choice) |
| `rubric` | `list` | `[]` | Level descriptions, lowest first (score) |

## Decide Yes/No

`decisions/DecideYesNo`

Ask the decision model a yes/no question and route on the answer.
`yes` is active when p_true reaches the threshold, `no` when 1 - p_true
reaches it, and `uncertain` otherwise, including when the decision model is
off or fails. Wire `uncertain` to a fallback, for example an LLM query.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state; the node sends the request only when a value reaches it |
| `subject` | `str,dict,list` | text or data the question is about (optional) |
| `instructions` | `str` | (optional) the question |
| `true_criteria` | `str` | when the answer is yes (optional) |
| `false_criteria` | `str` | when the answer is no (optional) |
| `threshold` | `int,float` | (optional) minimum probability for yes or no |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `yes` | `bool` | active when the answer is yes |
| `no` | `bool` | active when the answer is no |
| `uncertain` | `bool` | active when neither reaches the threshold or there is no answer |
| `p_true` | `float` | probability of yes, or None without an answer |
| `failure_code` | `str` | why there is no answer, or None |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `str` | `"Node graph question"` | Name of the request in the Decision Log |
| `instructions` | `text` | `""` | The question |
| `true_criteria` | `text` | `""` | When the answer is yes |
| `false_criteria` | `text` | `""` | When the answer is no |
| `threshold` | `number` | `0.9` | Minimum probability for yes or no. Range: 0.5 – 1.0. |

## Decision Model Status

`decisions/DecisionModelStatus`

Whether the decision model can answer questions now. Use it to skip
building an expensive state when no answer can come.

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ready` | `bool` | True when the decision model is on and its setup is complete |
| `enabled` | `bool` | True when the decision model is on |
| `status` | `str` | disabled, incomplete or ready |
| `provider` | `str` | the provider name, or None |
| `model` | `str` | the model id |
